about: Things that went in without being tried on a real screen. Whoever ships something untested adds a line here (newest first) and it shows on Server > Overview as 'Try these on a real screen'. Remove a line once it is old news.

items.title: Remove from Keep watching (it stays unwatched)
items.where: any screen · Home, hold OK (or press and hold, or right-click) on a Keep watching card

items.title: Score boxes in each site's colour, and Metacritic next to IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes
items.where: any screen · open a movie or show page, and a page in Requests

items.title: Season buttons show a thin line for how much of each season you've watched
items.where: any screen · open a show you're partway through

items.title: Phone notifications when your request arrives or a new episode of a show you watch lands
items.where: Android phone · open Glowfin once and allow notifications; pick which ones in Settings > Phones and TVs > Phone notifications

items.title: Resume shows a thin progress line inside it (phones also show the time left inside)
items.where: any screen · open a movie or episode you stopped partway through

items.title: What each person may do: away from home, downloads, deleting, Live TV, account on or off
items.where: any screen · Server > People, pick a person, What they may do (Allowed in the browser)

items.title: Fix details: change a title's name, year, age rating or description
items.where: TV or phone · hold OK (or press and hold) on a movie or show, Fix details

items.title: Jellyfin add-ons list with Update
items.where: any screen · Server > Tools > Tower > Jellyfin add-ons

items.title: Converting check reads Jellyfin's converting settings
items.where: any screen · Server > Tools > Playback fixes > Converting

items.title: Open in Jellyfin buttons land on the right Jellyfin page
items.where: phone or computer · Server > Tools > Tower > Rarely needed

items.title: Home shows the whole picture at the top on a phone, not a zoomed-in corner
items.where: phone held upright · Home, Movies or Shows (app and browser)

items.title: Harbor updates itself, with no command to paste
items.where: computer · Server > Tools > Tower > Setup command shows a Harbor line

items.title: The nightly safety copy gets made
items.where: any screen · Server > Tools > Tower > Safety copy, press Make one now

items.title: The Away check reads your internet name and its lock
items.where: any screen · Server > Tools > Tower > Away check

items.title: Updates check there's room first and clean up after themselves
items.where: any TV · Settings > Help > Install update

items.title: Every TV page starts at the same spot beside the menu
items.where: any TV · open Movies, Shows, Music and a title page

items.title: Music rows scroll fully into view
items.where: any TV · Music, press Down a few times

items.title: Search opens on the search box, and Left and Right can leave it
items.where: any TV · open Search

items.title: The "your request arrived" pop-up only informs and never catches OK
items.where: any TV · wait for a request to arrive

items.title: Stop and Changed my mind on the Manage board
items.where: phone or computer · Requests > Manage

items.title: Search results show sooner while you type
items.where: living room TV · Search, type a few letters

items.title: Picking a sound track works on the first try
items.where: any TV · play something with two languages, change Audio

items.title: What's the hold-up? on a request that is on its way
items.where: any screen · Requests, open something you said yes to

items.title: Glowfin for computers opens, plays and updates itself
items.where: Windows PC or Steam Deck

items.title: Three small stripes under the highlighted poster
items.where: any TV · Home, move along a row
